accent_rationale: Cyan is the channel default but reads as 'instrument/space'. FFI is a body horror story, so DS-004 shifts to violet — still cold, still clinical, but softer and more anatomical. Keeping it in the same luminance band as cyan preserves the HUD look.
working_title: Prions & Fatal Familial Insomnia: The Zero-DNA Protein That Survives Boiling Steel
